hook: Can my employer **fire me without notice?**

slides.title: First: are you a **'worker'?**
list: Covers people in an industry doing manual, clerical, technical work
Not: staff mainly in managerial or administrative roles
Not: supervisors earning over ₹18,000 a month
Not: armed forces, police or prison staff
slides.note: Not a 'worker'? These rules don't apply

slides.title: Retrenched? **One month's notice.**
slides.body: After at least one year of continuous service, you can't be retrenched until you get **one month's written notice** with reasons, or a month's wages instead.

slides.title: Plus **compensation.**
list: 15 days' average pay per completed year of service
A part-year over six months also counts
Employer must also serve notice on the government
15 days' last wages to a re-skilling fund

slides.title: Not every exit is **'retrenchment'.**
list: Non-renewal or end of a fixed-term contract

slides.title: 300+ workers? **Permission needed.**
slides.body: In a factory, mine or plantation with 300 or more workers (or a higher number notified by the appropriate Government), retrenchment needs **three months' notice** and prior government permission. Otherwise it is deemed illegal.

timeline.text: No result after 45 days? You can apply **directly to the Tribunal.**
Apply to the Tribunal within **two years** of the termination.

sources: Industrial Relations Code, 2020 – Sections 2(zh), 2(zr), 4(9)–(11), 70, 77, 79, 83, 104 (in force from 21 Nov 2025, PIB)
Industrial Relations Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act 1 of 2026) – Section 104
Ministry of Labour & Employment – FAQs on Labour Codes & Central Rules, as on 25.10.2026 (labour.gov.in)
caption:
Lost your job without notice? Here's what the Industrial Relations Code says. 👇

1️⃣ These rules protect a 'worker'. Staff mainly in managerial or administrative roles, and supervisors earning over ₹18,000 a month, are not 'workers'
2️⃣ A worker with one year's continuous service can't be retrenched without one month's written notice with reasons, or a month's wages instead
3️⃣ Retrenchment compensation is 15 days' average pay for every completed year of service
4️⃣ Dismissal as a disciplinary punishment, voluntary retirement, superannuation and end of a fixed-term contract are not 'retrenchment'
5️⃣ A factory, mine or plantation with 300+ workers needs three months' notice and prior government permission
6️⃣ To challenge a termination, apply to the conciliation officer; after 45 days you can go to the Tribunal, within two years
⚠️ The IR Code is in force from 21 Nov 2025 and replaced the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947

Source: Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (Sec 2, 4, 70, 77, 79, 83, 104)
